modules.title: Introduction to Vectors
modules.html:
Vector addition, scalar products and position vectors. This section covers introduction to vectors.

Key points

  • Find the angle between vectors $$\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{i} + \mathbf{j}$$ and $$\mathbf{b} = \mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j}$$. — $$90^\circ$$.
  • Scalar product of vectors $$\mathbf{a}=(1,2)$$ and $$\mathbf{b}=(3,4)$$ is: — $$11$$.
  • Find the dot product of vectors $$\mathbf{u} = 2\mathbf{i} + 3\mathbf{j}$$ and $$\mathbf{v} = -\mathbf{i} + 5\mathbf{j}$$. — $$13$$.
  • Find the angle between the vectors $$\mathbf{a} = 3\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}$$ and $$\mathbf{b} = 5\mathbf{i} + 12\mathbf{j}$$. — $$\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{63}{65}\right)$$.
  • Calculate the scalar product of vectors $\\mathbf{a} = 3i - 2j$ and $\\mathbf{b} = 4i + 5j$. — -2.

Worked examples

A: $$90^\circ$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$90^\circ$$.

A: $$11$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$11$$.
